title: Finite separable fixed field of an open subgroup
statement: Let K ⊂ Ω be a Galois field extension [def-pc-field-extension], with Ω/K separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension] and normal, and let H be an open subgroup of Gal(Ω/K). Then the fixed field L=Ω^H is finite-dimensional and separable over K, and the subgroup of Gal(Ω/K) fixing L pointwise is H.
